result.instructions: Tools for Healthchecks.io, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Healthchecks.io data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run healthchecksio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run healthchecksio_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run healthchecksio_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. healthchecksio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: healthchecksio_list_checks
tools.title: List checks
tools.description: List all checks in the project, optionally filtered by slug and/or tags. Returns {checks:[...]} — each check's status, schedule, last ping, and ping URL. Healthchecks: GET /checks/.

slug.description: Filter to checks with this exact slug.

tag.description: Filter to checks carrying ALL of these tags (each is sent as a separate `tag` query param).

tools.name: healthchecksio_get_check
tools.title: Get check
tools.description: Get a single check by its UUID (or its unique read-only key). Returns the check's full state — status, timeout/schedule, grace, tags, last ping. Healthchecks: GET /checks/{uuid}.

uuid.description: The check's UUID, or its unique read-only key.

tools.name: healthchecksio_list_pings
tools.title: List pings
tools.description: List a check's logged pings (100 on the free plan, 1000 on paid), most recent first. Each ping: type, date, n, scheme, remote_addr, method, ua, rid, duration, body_url. Healthchecks: GET /checks/{uuid}/pings/.

tools.name: healthchecksio_get_ping_body
tools.title: Get ping body
tools.description: Get the logged request body of a single ping, returned as PLAIN TEXT (verbatim, not JSON). Healthchecks: GET /checks/{uuid}/pings/{n}/body.

n.description: The ping's sequence number (the `n` field from list_pings).

tools.name: healthchecksio_list_flips
tools.title: List flips
tools.description: List a check's status changes ("flips") over time — [{timestamp, up}]. Optionally scope by a lookback window or an explicit start/end range. Healthchecks: GET /checks/{uuid}/flips/.

seconds.description: Return only flips from the last N seconds.

start.description: Return only flips at/after this Unix timestamp.

end.description: Return only flips at/before this Unix timestamp.

tools.name: healthchecksio_list_integrations
tools.title: List integrations
tools.description: List the project's notification integrations ("channels") — {channels:[{id, name, kind}]}. The ids are what you assign to a check's `channels` field. Healthchecks: GET /channels/.

tools.name: healthchecksio_list_badges
tools.title: List badges
tools.description: List the project's status-badge URLs per tag (plus "*" for the overall status) — {badges:{...}}. Healthchecks: GET /badges/.

tools.name: healthchecksio_create_check
tools.title: Create check
tools.description: CREATES a new check — this MODIFIES live monitoring config. Provide a `timeout` (simple period-based check) OR a `schedule` + `tz` (cron-based check); the two are mutually exclusive. Use `unique` to avoid creating duplicates. Assign notifications via `channels`. Healthchecks: POST /checks/. Returns the created check (201) or the existing match (200).

slug.description: URL slug (used for slug-based ping URLs).

tags.description: Space-separated list of tags, e.g. "prod db backups".

timeout.description: Expected period between pings, in seconds (60..31536000). Mutually exclusive with `schedule`.

grace.description: Grace time in seconds after the deadline before the check goes down.

schedule.description: Cron expression for the expected ping schedule (e.g. "15 5 * * *"). Mutually exclusive with `timeout`; requires `tz`.

tz.description: Server's timezone for the cron `schedule`, e.g. "Europe/Riga".

manual_resume.description: If true, a paused check does not auto-resume on the next ping (resume manually).

channels.description: Integrations to assign: "*" for all, or a comma-separated list of integration ids.

unique.description: Dedupe fields — if a check already matches on these (e.g. ["name"]), it is returned instead of created.

tools.name: healthchecksio_update_check
tools.title: Update check
tools.description: UPDATES an existing check by UUID — this MODIFIES live monitoring config. Send only the fields you want to change (timeout and schedule remain mutually exclusive). Healthchecks: POST /checks/{uuid}. Returns the updated check.

tags.description: Space-separated list of tags, e.g. "prod db backups".

tools.name: healthchecksio_pause_check
tools.title: Pause check
tools.description: PAUSES a check — disables monitoring without deleting it (it stops going down for missed pings until it next receives a ping or is resumed). This MODIFIES live monitoring config. Healthchecks: POST /checks/{uuid}/pause (empty body).

tools.name: healthchecksio_resume_check
tools.title: Resume check
tools.description: RESUMES a paused check — re-enables monitoring. This MODIFIES live monitoring config. Returns HTTP 409 (surfaced cleanly) if the check is not currently paused. Healthchecks: POST /checks/{uuid}/resume (empty body).

tools.name: healthchecksio_delete_check
tools.title: Delete check
tools.description: PERMANENTLY DELETES a check by UUID — this MODIFIES live monitoring config and cannot be undone. Healthchecks: DELETE /checks/{uuid}. Returns the deleted check's last known state.
